purpose: Teach: ヴァン/タナ/サーキット/アロマ/ウルトラマン/エヴァ/ドス/ゴキブリ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがヴァン・モリソンのCDを蔵書された
lines.en: Dear, back when we were young, Father kept a whole collection of Van Morrison CDs.
lines.style: Slow wistful opening, gaze-into-the-distance tone, measured pauses between phrases, gentle fade at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お孫様のタナくんを可愛がられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and he doted so on little Tana, his grandson, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft agreeing hum to start, papery warmth, tender lift on the name, gentle questioning close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがF1サーキットの中継を観られた
lines.en: Dear, in those days Father used to watch the F1 circuit broadcasts.
lines.style: Measured and quiet, a small fond smile surfacing mid-memory, unhurried trailing finish.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、私にアロマランプを下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when we were young, you gave me an aroma lamp, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Shy pleasure warming the line, slowing on the gift, affectionate rising tag at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがウルトラマンを子供達に見せられた
lines.en: Dear, Father used to sit the children down in front of Ultraman.
lines.style: Low and warm, faint amusement at the memory, deliberate pauses, softly savored ending.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、エヴァ、つまりエヴァンゲリオンの放映を観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you watched Eva when it aired — Evangelion, I mean — didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle teasing lilt, careful on the unfamiliar title, warm rising check at the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがドスの効いた歌声で唸られた
lines.en: Dear, Father would growl out songs in that deep, gravelly voice of his.
lines.style: Quiet chuckle underneath, voice dipping low to suggest the growl, then settling back gently.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ゴキブリ退治を御自らされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And back then you always dealt with the cockroaches yourself, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm proud finish, slow affectionate pace, small laugh folded into the final question.
